manzana: A single shiny red apple with a short brown stem and one green leaf, glossy skin with a soft golden blush near the top.
zanahoria: A single fresh orange carrot standing upright on its thick end, gentle ridges along it, with a bushy tuft of three green leaves on top.
pan: A rustic crusty bread loaf, a golden-brown oval batard with three diagonal scored cuts showing lighter crumb, lightly dusted with flour.
arroz: A deep navy-blue ceramic bowl heaped with fluffy white steamed rice, a small red pickled plum on top and two light wooden chopsticks resting across the rim.

festin: A round wooden serving board with a small feast on it: a crusty golden bread roll, a red apple, a bunch of purple grapes, a wedge of yellow cheese and an orange carrot.

jabon: A rounded bar of forest-green soap with a little heap of white foam bubbles on top.
pelota: A bouncy rubber ball, glossy brick red with a white band around it and two small yellow stars.
peonza: A wooden spinning top toy with a pointed tip, painted in navy blue, sunny yellow and red stripes, with a dark wooden handle stem on top.
peluche: A small plush teddy bear toy sitting, caramel-brown fabric, cream muzzle and paws, black button eyes and a red ribbon bow at its neck.
cometa: A diamond-shaped kite standing upright, four fabric panels in navy blue, ember orange, sunny yellow and red on a light wooden cross frame, with a short tail of small bows.
